note: S3 model cards, 17 Oct 2026. Not registered on the event log yet (S1 builds it). Synthetic simulator output; nothing here is real Tejas / IAF / F404 data or validated physics. These results show the pipeline works on simulated or generated data, not that it would predict real failures.

training_worlds.builder: proto/runner/train_worlds.py: TailRunner(tail, 735, root=0x7A10000 + seed), station routine, Arrow IPC store (ipcstore.store_class)
training_worlds.where: LinuxONE server, 2 workers, numba stand-in; 3,441 s wall; 104-261 s and up to 773 MB per world

models.artifact: proto/runs/train/hazard_model.json (kind age, fitted on seeds 1-4; server copy is what the live twin reads)
models.method: installation spells from COMPONENT_LIFE (redacted serials repaired); event = removal with a CONFIRMED or BCM shop finding, not hard-time (MAL-HT), linked by job + serial + time (ties and redacted serials by item hours); three kinds, ridge 0.1 partial pooling across classes: class_exp (events per FH), age (Weibull AFT on time since install, class in scale and shape), landmark (Weibull AFT on residual life at 10-FH landmarks with age, class alarms in last 10 FH, alarm rate, prior RTOKs of the serial, inferred-install flag); challenger chosen on validation seed 3, promoted only if it beats class_exp on held-out seed 4; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE under 10 events; removal_risk_30d with 80 % interval

G-COUNT-BEFORE-FIT.evidence: train_counts.md written before any fit: 1,427 shop findings, 123 CONFIRMED (62 linked and not hard-time, 15 not linkable), 27 BCM, 1,277 RTOK, 102 not linkable; 80 hazard events (77 HYDP, 1 ENG, 1 GEN, 1 RADAR); 89 linked fault-confirmed findings, 9 of which were not attached to an installation spell (not investigated further)

G-MIN-EVENTS.evidence: fitted: HYDP (77 events). INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: ADC, AMAGB, BCU, BRAKE, CHUTE, DFCC, ENG, FADEC, FQGS, GEN, INGPS, JFS, OBOGS, RADAR, TYRE. BRAKE CONFIRMED findings are hard-time wear (31 of 39; 8 unlinked). No stress scenario used (trimmed scope).

G-BACKTEST.result: PASS: age promoted over the class-exposure baseline
G-BACKTEST.evidence: train 1-3, test 4, 15-FH horizon, HYDP, 346 landmarks / 28 events: class-exposure Brier 0.074414 (AUC 0.5, C 0.5); age Brier 0.059378 (AUC 0.903, C-index 0.8302); landmark covariates Brier 0.075439 (AUC 0.896, C 0.8225)

G-CALIBRATION.evidence: champion quintiles predicted / observed: 0.003/0.014, 0.018/0.000, 0.049/0.000, 0.098/0.043, 0.202/0.348 — under-predicts the oldest spells

G-CHALLENGER-SELECTION.evidence: validation seed 3 (fit on 1-2), HYDP landmark Brier: age 0.059313, landmark covariates 0.069978

G-COVARIATES.evidence: landmark AFT effects (log residual life): age -0.0014, alarms_last10 -0.0476, alarm_rate +0.0779, prior_rtok -0.0254, inferred_install +0.0083 — alarms add almost nothing: in these worlds HYDP alarms are mostly not pump faults

champion.label: Weibull AFT on age, partially pooled
champion.why: beats the class-exposure baseline on held-out seed 4; chosen over the landmark covariate model on validation seed 3
champion.lens_text: hazard 0.2.0 age — champion: Weibull AFT on age (held-out Brier 0.0594 vs class-exposure baseline 0.0744); classes under 10 confirmed removals: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

models.method: takeoff-snapshot corrected EGT margin (830 degC redline, theta^0.5 correction); Kalman local linear trend in engine flight hours; one-sided CUSUM on standardised innovations (k 0.5, h 5); washes (fleet INSPECTION/WASH CLOSED) as known change points; days to margin limit = 10th percentile of Monte Carlo over the (level, slope) posterior at the engine's 30-day flying rate
models.tuning: settings fixed by hand before evaluation; not tuned on the evaluated data

G-OVERLAY-CONTRACT.evidence: overlay_gonogo_check.json: 598 overlay files (Arrow IPC) all carry contract 0.2.0 hash a4396f1d...; delta rows inside (22 Jun 06:00, 23 Jun 06:00] IST; fleet/ tree unchanged; repeat call identical

G-DETECT-PLANTED.evidence: training overlay (4 worlds, 730 d): 8 of 8 planted faults detected, all before the true margin reached 0 degC, median 6.95 d after onset; live gonogo run: 2 of 2 (7.9 d and 1.1 d after onset)

G-LEAD-TIME.evidence: 6 faults reached the true limit within the data: lead time from alert to limit 77.1-301.8 d (median 156.9 d); 2 did not reach it (3.6 and 18.0 degC left)

G-FALSE-ALARMS.evidence: training overlay: 3 episodes in 9,025 healthy flights = 0.033 per 100 flights; gonogo: 0 in 531; tracking RMSE 0.77-0.90 degC
